title: Parcel (v1 success response)
description: Returned with 201 Created (new parcel, plus a Location header) and 200 OK (idempotent replay, plus 'Idempotent-Replayed: true'); a replay returns the identical body. `id` stays a top-level field as in the original v1 response, so existing clients keep working. Clients MUST ignore unknown fields: new fields may be added within v1.

id.description: Opaque parcel ID. Do not parse.

size.description: Always the canonical value, even if an alias was sent.

status.description: Known values: created. Clients MUST tolerate new values.
